operations.title: The two local Kummer generators are tetrahedral normal functions
operations.body: For a six-mark representative, the two-dimensional anti-invariant cokernel has two primitive left-null generators, each an alternating (1,-1,1,-1) combination of four labelled triple deck divisors. Their possible W5-to-W6 extensions are Abel-Jacobi/generalized-Jacobian normal functions, not ordinary incidence differentials.

operations.title: Exact anti-incidence cokernel-generator extraction
operations.body: The checker constructs the representative anti-invariant matrix, computes its integral left nullspace, and exports the two four-supported labelled generators.

operations.title: Benincasa types the remaining W5-to-W6 extension problem
operations.body: Entry 1191 extracts the two local W6- generators explicitly. Each is a tetrahedral alternating (1,-1,1,-1) combination of four off-branch divisors [p+]-[p-]. Hence the remaining extension is a pair of Abel-Jacobi/generalized-Jacobian normal functions. Incidence alone cannot decide whether the four images cancel after transport to a common relative Jacobian. The exact next gate is the source-derived 1-motive/common-Jacobian comparison; no scalar connection or support fitting is authorized.

authority_basis.summary: Record the exact tetrahedral generators and their Abel-Jacobi normal-function typing.
